newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks close higher, led by banks.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks close higher, led by banks.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed higher, boosted by gains in banking shares amid healthy volumes, traders said.
Bogota's IBB index edged up 0.15 percent to 839.17 in a 3.97 billion peso volume while Medellin's IBOMED index rose 0.46 percent to 13,267.84 in a 3.35 billion peso volume.

"There was quite a bit of speculation in the market driven by rumors of imminent bank restructuring while other shares rose as stockholders looked to inflate prices before year end," one Bogota trader said.
